comment: I really like professor Cheever, and her class lectures are very enjoyable. However, her grading is ridiculously tough. I have spent tons of time on assignments, too much time, making sure I follow the rules of the rubric. She still nitpicks at little things and gives very average grades. I do like the class, but her grading is too tough.

Cheever is smart and cares deeply about her students. As long as you show up and make an effort to participate, she is super chill on grading. Even though there aren't a ton of graded assignments, your final grade will reflect the amount of effort you put into the class, not just test grades. She made me want to major in film!
Film history is a very interesting class. Dr. Cheevers' lectures are pretty insightful, too. She is a tough grader, though.

Just show up to class, watch the movies, do the readings, and participate once or twice. She is super knowledgable and funny but can definitely tell who actually does the work - if you do, she is super gracious with grading.

Please don't take this class if you are trying to get a gen ed requirement out of the way. Mandatory readings due before every class, you're lucky if theyre under 30 pages. Professor also has bad days and you don't want to be in class when she does. The midterm and final were very hard and not related to what we talked about during class.

SO MUCH work: hour long movies, one book every week, 4 essays, group projects, multiple readings. It never stopped. In class was completely the opposite though, just discussion based over readings or films. Take this class only if you are truly passionate about film or else you just will just be overwhelmed AND bored. did I mention she grades tough

Professor Cheever is one of my favorite professors. She cares about students' success and makes sure that if you go to her for help, she is available. She is passionate and knowledgeable about her subject, and her courses combine what one associates with "film studies" with historical, sociological, and cultural contexts. Great Prof!

Gave us a six page final to do in 48 hours. The prompts given have almost nothing to do with the films in class. There are readings often however they are interesting to read and important for discussion. She sometimes gets into bad moods and will be quite rude, was nice other than that. I would like to take her again to prove I could, not for fun.

Class is pretty interesting and she is very nice. But the grading is ridiculous. I have taken other film studies classes and as an introductory one her grading is too tough. Not enough time given on exams (midterm) as multiple people did not finish sinks your grade. Also essay prompts are extremely abstract and have limited relevancy to the class

Dr. Cheever is super nice and understanding. The papers and tests are fairly difficult, but your grade can be boosted with participation and the group assignments. Overall, I enjoyed the class for a subject I wasn't interested in.

I loved Dr. Cheever and her class!! She is funny and inspirational. It is a reading heavy class, and readings are important for participation. However, they were very interesting. She connects the movies to larger concepts. She isn't an easy grader but she grades fairly and gives good feedback. Take her! One of the best profs I had here!
Professor Cheever was awesome. She was enthusiastic in class and a fair grader. Couldn't have asked for a better experience in my first film studies class.

Dr. Cheever is inspirational, and so passionate in her stuffs, she is so good at engaging students into class discussions and those discussions were inspirational if you read the material. The class was hard for me but all the time I spent on the course was worthy and I love the inspirational feedbacks she gives for every assignments. Take it!

TAKE HER! One of the most caring and approachable professors I've had. She is so engaging and fosters an environment in which people want to participate. She also loves to learn right alongside us, therefore really bridging that professor-student gap. So fun, kind, inspiring, and unforgettable!

She's a good professor but definitely has her days. There is a lot of reading in addition to watching the films. I personally didn't buy the textbooks or books for the class and I am doing fine, and one of them has an e-text available on the library website. It's definite not an easy class but its not too terrible and is good for an English gen ed.

I cannot say how grateful I am for Dr. Cheever. She is an incredible person, so thoughtful and kind, asks powerful questions, and truly passionate about her subject matter. She wants you to truly understand what you learn and master it, and she gives thorough and honest feedback. Without a doubt, my favorite professor. You will come away enriched.

Dr. Cheever is a good person but a bad professor. She will lead you to believe that the class is easy and you can do well but she will make it the hardest thing ever! She is a really tough grader and will give you feedback based on what she wants from you. You will not get a good grade even if you do what she says. DO NOT TAKE HER!

Professor Cheever is hilarious. She's a hard core feminist which is nice at times but also not. The material she taught was interesting and she knew her stuff. She grades hard on essays  so work hard on them (go see her several times beforehand).

VERY helpful if you go see her.  If not, it's going to be a very difficult class.  She is extremely helpful in guiding students in the right direction for paper.  seriously, go see her for EVERY assignment.  The reason for my low grade was I didn't go in and see her on all of my assignments.
she gives alot of reading and she is not an easy grader. This is not the easy A u r hoping to get. Sorry but she is a great teacher
BEST teacher i've ever had. hilarious. extremely smart. fair. INTERESTING. TAKE HER!!!!!
WONDERFUL professor and person!!!  By FAR, my favorite professor on campus!  Challenging but humorous at the same time.  Down to earth and always willing to help!  TAKE HER!!!

She is so amazing!!!  So much fun and very witty!  She will make you work, but in a good way.  She really enhances your reading and writing abilities! You can always talk to her about anything!  I HIGHLY recommend her!!!  You will NOT regret it!!!

She is one of the more intellectual professors I have come across at Richmond.  Not to mention she is also a hoot.  She really knows her material, and expects students to do the reading.  Definitely not an easy A, but such a price must be forfeited in order to learn from one of the department's best professors.
Cheever is the bomb dot com / scrumptrulescent. If you want to learn from a great professor, then sign up for one of her classes. Now I know what it's like to look forward to class...

At first she comes off as really intimidating and her humor takes a while to get used to. But as you get to know her she is SO funny and keeps the class engaged. She is SO smart and always has really insightful comments on the books which always sparks interesting discussions. She encourages humor and our core class has fun.

She is very knowledgable and engages herself in discussions rather than sitting back and allowing awkward silences to form. She assigns a max of 60 pages of reading each night - excellent compared to most Core professors who assign at least 100. She is also very friendly and answers e-mails quickly... and sometimes brings us coffee and doughnuts!

I really enjoyed this class.  She's a very funny person who expects a good amount of effort from her students.  Incorporates philosophy with film studies in a seamless fashion, that really makes you think.  Highly recommended.

This is the class I've hated most in college.  If you give a bad grade that's one thing, but you have to at least explain why the grade was given.  Seems like she could be a nice person but it just doesn't come off in class for some reason.
She is a tough grader but she is fun. She makes the class fun.
No Comments

Although she can be a difficult grader at times, she is an overall nice woman if you approach her in the right way. She adds a touch of sarcasm and wit to liven things up. I would recommend her for the Intro to Film Studies class that I took with her.
